items.title_en: Ranthambore tiger naps on road, leaves 30 safari jeeps waiting: ‘Classic India Traffic jam’
items.title_zh: Ranthambore老虎在路上打盹，留下30辆狩猎吉普车等待：“经典的印度交通堵塞”
items.summary_en: In the clip, the tiger can be seen lying comfortably on the road while several safari jeeps wait nearby. Tourists appear to be keeping their distance as they watch the animal rest.
items.summary_zh: 在视频中，可以看到老虎舒适地躺在路上，而几辆狩猎吉普车则在附近等候。游客在观看动物休息时似乎保持距离。

items.title_en: Rs 2,600 cr wealth: Zepto co-founder, not Aadit Palicha, is India’s youngest rich lister
items.title_zh: 2,600 卢比财富：Zepto 联合创始人，而不是 Aadit Palicha，是印度最年轻的富豪榜
items.summary_en: At just 23, Kaivalya Vohra has a reported wealth of Rs 2,600 crore, while his Zepto co-founder Aadit Palicha, 24, has accumulated Rs 3,500 crore.
items.summary_zh: 年仅 23 岁的 Kaivalya Vohra 据报道拥有 260 亿卢比的财富，而他的 Zepto 联合创始人 24 岁的 Aadit Palicha 则积累了 350 亿卢比的财富。

items.title_en: M3M Hurun India Rich List 2026: Gautam Adani reclaims top spot from Mukesh Ambani in M3M Hurun India Rich List
items.title_zh: 2026 年 M3M 胡润印度富豪榜：高塔姆·阿达尼 (Gautam Adani) 从穆克什·安巴尼 (Mukesh Ambani) 手中夺回 M3M 胡润印度富豪榜榜首
items.summary_en: Headlined by Gautam Adani's return to rank #1, the 2026 M3M Hurun India Rich List highlights 1,810 individuals holding wealth equal to nearly half of India's GDP.
items.summary_zh: 以高塔姆·阿达尼 (Gautam Adani) 重返第一名为主角，2026 年 M3M 胡润印度富豪榜重点关注了 1,810 名个人，其财富相当于印度 GDP 的近一半。

items.title_en: How much does a family need to earn in the US? NRI breaks down H-1B salaries
items.title_zh: 一个家庭在美国需要赚多少钱？ NRI 细分 H-1B 薪资
items.summary_en: Aniruddha Anjana, a US startup owner who spent 10 years in America before moving back to India, shared the calculations in an Instagram post.
items.summary_zh: Aniruddha Anjana 是一位美国初创公司老板，他在美国生活了 10 年，然后才回到印度，他在 Instagram 帖子中分享了计算结果。

items.title_en: Top 10 best airlines in the world: Singapore Airlines ranks No. 1; check full list
items.title_zh: 全球最佳航空公司前10名：新加坡航空排名第一；检查完整列表
items.summary_en: Singapore Airlines dethrones Qatar Airways to be named as the World's best airline in 2026.
items.summary_zh: 新加坡航空取代卡塔尔航空，成为 2026 年全球最佳航空公司。

items.title_en: ‘They called me crazy’: Why this Pakistani man grew 5,700 plants in his tiny home
items.title_zh: “他们说我疯了”：为什么这位巴基斯坦男子在他的小家里种植了 5,700 株植物
items.summary_en: For Asghar, the greenery is more than an ambitious gardening project. It is a way of keeping alive a wish his mother once shared with him.
items.summary_zh: 对于阿斯加尔来说，绿化不仅仅是一个雄心勃勃的园艺项目。这是实现他母亲曾经与他分享的愿望的一种方式。

items.title_en: ‘Is this the new iPhone?’: Thieves ask Noida woman about phone model before snatching it
items.title_zh: “这是新 iPhone 吗？”：窃贼在抢走手机前向诺伊达女子询问手机型号
items.summary_en: The incident took place when Shubhi Bhandari took out her new phone to make an online payment to an e-rickshaw in Greater Noida.
items.summary_zh: 事件发生时，舒比·班达里 (Shubhi Bhandari) 拿出她的新手机，向大诺伊达的一辆电动人力车进行在线支付。

items.title_en: ‘Never too late to make a change’: Chinese doctor leaves medicine for bun shop
items.title_zh: “改变永远不晚”：中医把药留给包子店
items.summary_en: Despite initial family opposition, the former doctor has since expanded her bun business to two outlets.
items.summary_zh: 尽管最初遭到家人的反对，这位前医生还是将她的包子生意扩大到了两家分店。

items.title_en: Jon-Erik Hexum, The Up-And-Coming Actor Who Was Killed In One Of Hollywood’s Most Tragic On-Set Accidents
items.title_zh: 乔恩-埃里克·赫克瑟姆 (Jon-Erik Hexum)，在好莱坞最悲惨的片场事故之一中丧生的新晋演员
items.summary_en: Harry Langdon/Flickr Celebrated as the next big Hollywood actor in the 1980s, an on-set gun accident cost Jon-Erik Hexum his life. The death and violence portrayed in shows and movies is fake. But real-life fatalities have occured in Hollywood. In 1993, actor Brandon Lee was accidentally shot to death; in 2021, so was cinematographer Halyna Hutchins.
items.summary_zh: 哈里·兰登 (Harry Langdon)/Flickr 被誉为 20 世纪 80 年代下一位好莱坞大牌演员的乔恩·埃里克·赫克萨姆 (Jon-Erik Hexum) 因一场现场枪击事故丧生。电视剧和电影中描绘的死亡和暴力都是假的。但现实生活中的死亡事件却在好莱坞发生过。 1993年，演员李国豪意外被枪杀； 2021 年，电影摄影师 Halyna Hutchins 也是如此。

items.title_en: Who Was Green Boots? The Story Of The Man Behind Mt. Everest’s Most Famous Body
items.title_zh: 谁是绿靴子？珠穆朗玛峰最著名的身体背后的人的故事
items.summary_en: Maxwelljo40/Wikimedia Commons The corpse known as “Green Boots” has sat on Mt. Everest for more than 30 years. More than 200 bodies litter Mount Everest. They are the corpses of ambitious climbers ranging from amateur dreamers to experienced mountaineers.
items.summary_zh: Maxwelljo40/Wikimedia Commons 这具被称为“绿靴子”的尸体已经在珠穆朗玛峰上躺了 30 多年。珠穆朗玛峰上有超过 200 具尸体。他们是雄心勃勃的登山者的尸体，从业余梦想家到经验丰富的登山者。

items.title_en: Soldiers In South Korea Were Sweeping For Landmines And Uncovered The Oldest Gunpowder Weapon Ever Found In The Country’s History
items.title_zh: 韩国士兵正在扫雷并发现了该国历史上最古老的火药武器
items.summary_en: Korea Heritage Service South Korean soldiers on a mine-detection operation discovered a small bronze hand cannon, the oldest gunpowder weapon ever found in the country. South Korean soldiers sweeping Mount Geumseong for landmines unexpectedly discovered a small bronze cannon that dates back 600 years, making it the country’s oldest-known gunpowder weapon ever found. The weapon, known as “Hwangja Hwatong,” also features an inscription that records its name, weight, age, provenance, and manufacturer. This…
items.summary_zh: 韩国文化遗产厅的韩国士兵在一次探雷行动中发现了一门小型青铜手炮，这是该国迄今为止发现的最古老的火药武器。韩国士兵在金城山扫雷时意外发现了一门小青铜大炮，其历史可以追溯到 600 年前，是该国迄今为止发现的最古老的火药武器。该武器被称为“Hwangja Hwatong”，还刻有铭文，记录了其名称、重量、年龄、经证实的

items.title_en: On the Trail of the Mothman
items.summary_en: Listen and subscribe on Apple Podcasts , Spotify , and all major podcast apps. Amanda McGowan : Every small town has that one spot where people sneak off to at night. In Point Pleasant, West Virginia, back in the 1960s, that place was the McClintic Wildlife Management Area. The locals called it the TNT area.
items.summary_zh: 在 Apple 播客、Spotify 和所有主要播客应用程序上收听和订阅。阿曼达·麦高恩：每个小镇都有一个人们晚上偷偷去的地方。早在 20 世纪 60 年代，西弗吉尼亚州的波因特普莱森特 (Point Pleasant) 就是麦克林蒂克野生动物管理区 (McClintic Wildlife Management Area)。当地人称其为TNT地区。
